match_case_results.description: exact matches through plural / prep-word normalization
match_case_results.derivation: Onions->onion, fresh thyme->thyme ('fresh' is a prep word), potatoes->potato; olive oil and vegetable stock are protected two-word terms kept whole. All 5 of 5 present: 5/5 = 1.0.

match_case_results.description: synonym matches: scallions=spring onions, white rice=rice, cilantro=coriander
match_case_results.derivation: Recipe: Chicken Salt Pepper 'Ginger Cordial' Ginger 'Spring Onions' Rice Water Coriander (9). Synonym table: spring onion(s) and scallion(s) -> green onion; white rice -> rice; coriander -> cilantro. 'ginger cordial' is not 'ginger' (extra word 'cordial' is no cut/variety), so missing (important). 8 matched / 9 = 0.8889.

match_case_results.description: specificity, pantry MORE specific: chicken thighs satisfy 'chicken' fully
match_case_results.derivation: 'chicken thigh' has every word of 'chicken' plus 'thigh', a listed cut: full match. 'Granulated sugar' resolves to sugar (synonym) and is not in the pantry; sake and potato starch absent; none has a substitution. 6 matched / 9 = 0.6667; chicken (critical) is matched, so can cook.

match_case_results.description: specificity, pantry LESS specific: generic chicken for 'chicken breast' is a partial
match_case_results.derivation: Recipe: 'Enchilada sauce' 'shredded Monterey Jack cheese' 'corn tortillas' 'chicken breasts' (4). The recipe wants 'chicken breast'; pantry 'chicken' lacks 'breast', a listed cut: partial, worth 0.7. Monterey Jack is not a cut/variety word, so the cheese is missing. (2 + 0.7)/4 = 0.675. The partial is the critical item and is NOT critical-missing.

match_case_results.description: protected term: sweet potato must not satisfy potato
match_case_results.derivation: 'sweet potato' is protected, so it is not 'potato' plus a variety word. Potatoes is the critical ingredient and is missing. base 4/5 = 0.8, minus 0.3 for one critical missing = 0.5. The score reaches the 0.5 threshold, but a critical ingredient is missing, so can_cook is False.

match_case_results.description: protected term: cream must not satisfy cream cheese
match_case_results.derivation: Recipe: Butter 'Egg Yolks'[c] 'Cream Cheese' 'Baking Powder' Flour Jam (6). Pantry 'cream' resolves through the synonym table to heavy cream, which is not cream cheese (protected). Flour resolves to all purpose flour on both sides. 5/6 = 0.8333.

match_case_results.description: protected term that can collapse: 'hot sauce' must not become plain 'sauce'
match_case_results.derivation: Recipe: Fries, 'Doner Meat', 'Garlic sauce', Hotsauce, Lettuce, Tomato, Cucumber, 'Gouda cheese' (8). Synonym table: hotsauce -> hot sauce. 'hot' is a prep modifier that normalization strips, so 'hot sauce' survives only because it is a PROTECTED term; without protection it would collapse to 'sauce' and be satisfied by the pantry's generic 'sauce'. It must not be: hot sauce is missing (important). 'Fries' singularizes to 'fry'. 7 of 8 matched = 0.875, nothing critical missing. [Replaced after the first run. The original d3_07 (pantry 'cream cheese' against a recipe's 'heavy cream') passed, but a mutation check showed it could not fail on protected-term logic: both names carry an extra word, so they never match whatever is protected. This case can fail: it is the one place PROTECTED_TERMS changes an outcome, because 'hot' is stripped as a prep word.]

match_case_results.description: protected term: spring onion (green onion) must not satisfy onion
match_case_results.derivation: spring onions -> green onion (synonym), which is protected and not 'onion' plus a variety word. Onion (important) is missing; 5/6 = 0.8333.

match_case_results.description: specificity full by colour + optional-only gaps still cook
match_case_results.derivation: 'red onion' is 'onion' plus the listed variety word 'red': full match. The two missing items are both optional, so nothing critical is missing: 4/6 = 0.6667, can cook.

match_case_results.description: substitution applied: oat milk for milk
match_case_results.derivation: Substitutions table: milk -> almond milk / oat milk / soy milk (all 1:1, minimal). Pantry has oat milk. 6 matched + 1 substituted: (6 + 0.7)/7 = 0.9571.

match_case_results.description: substitution applied: evaporated milk for heavy cream (no restriction)
match_case_results.derivation: Substitutions: heavy cream -> evaporated milk (1:1, minimal). (5 + 0.7)/6 = 0.95.

match_case_results.description: substitution REJECTED on dietary grounds: evaporated milk is not dairy-free
match_case_results.derivation: Same pantry as d3_11 but dairy_free is requested. 'evaporated milk' is a dairy term, so the substitute is ineligible and heavy cream stays missing: 5/6 = 0.8333. (The matched items are not second-guessed: the pantry already holds them.)

match_case_results.description: critical missing forces can_cook False even though the score clears 0.5
match_case_results.derivation: Chicken Legs is critical and absent; 'chicken stock' is a protected term and is not a chicken leg. base 6/7 = 0.8571, minus 0.3 = 0.5571 (above 0.5) but can_cook is False. [Corrected after the first run: the matched name was originally written as 'chicken stock', wrongly treating 'cube' as a stripped container word. 'cube' is not in the container-word list, so the normalized name is 'chicken stock cube' on both sides. Classification and score were already right.]

match_case_results.description: empty pantry: everything missing, score clamped to 0
match_case_results.derivation: Nothing matched: base 0, minus 0.3 for the critical potato = -0.3, clamped to 0.0.

match_case_results.description: below the threshold with no critical gap: can_cook False
match_case_results.derivation: 2 of 6 = 0.3333 < 0.5 and no ingredient is critical, so it is the threshold alone that blocks cooking.

match_case_results.description: exactly at the threshold: score 0.5 can cook
match_case_results.derivation: 3/6 = 0.5, which meets 'at least 0.5'; nothing critical is missing.

match_case_results.description: long-expired pantry item (3 days past) is excluded from matching entirely
match_case_results.derivation: Grace is 2 days past shelf life; potatoes at -3 are waste and are not offered to the matcher, so the critical potato is missing exactly as in d3_05: 0.8 - 0.3 = 0.5, can_cook False.

match_case_results.description: pantry item exactly 2 days past (within grace) or with unknown age still counts
match_case_results.derivation: -2 is within the 2-day grace and None means age unknown: both are usable. 5/5 = 1.0.

match_case_results.description: avoid-list exclusion: avoiding mushroom removes Chicken Marengo
match_case_results.derivation: The match itself is perfect (7/7 = 1.0) but the recipe contains mushrooms, so it must be excluded from the candidates. [Corrected after the first run: the matched name was originally written as 'chicken stock', same slip as d3_13.]

match_case_results.description: avoid-list exclusion: cilantro and coriander are the same herb
match_case_results.derivation: The recipe lists 'Coriander Leaves'; avoiding cilantro must exclude it. Match: 6/7 = 0.8571 with only the optional coriander (-> cilantro) missing.

match_case_results.description: avoid-list exclusion: a category word (dairy) excludes a recipe made of its members
match_case_results.derivation: Milk, double cream, butter and parmesan cheese are all dairy: excluded. Match 7/7 = 1.0 (parmesan cheese resolves to parmesan).

match_case_results.description: avoid-list negative: nothing in Boulangere Potatoes is a nut or dairy
match_case_results.derivation: Onions, thyme, olive oil, potatoes, vegetable stock: no nut, no dairy. Not excluded.

match_case_results.description: optional-only gaps: missing salt and coriander still cook
match_case_results.derivation: Both missing items are optional. 5/7 = 0.7143, nothing critical missing, can cook. 'Corn Flour' is protected and kept whole.

match_case_results.description: a duplicated recipe line counts twice
match_case_results.derivation: 'Caster Sugar' appears on two lines; each resolves to sugar and each is matched by the one pantry sugar. 6 entries, 6 matched: 1.0.

match_case_results.description: container words and prep words: 'can of kidney beans', 'canned tomatoes'
match_case_results.derivation: 'can of' and 'canned' are container words, 'Chopped' a prep word: kidney bean, tomato. Mixed Grain missing (important). 3/4 = 0.75; the critical kidney bean is matched.

match_case_results.description: synonym on a repeated line: powdered sugar = icing sugar
match_case_results.derivation: Icing Sugar appears twice and resolves to powdered sugar (synonym table): both lines matched. Orange Blossom Water missing. 5/6 = 0.8333.

match_case_results.description: synonyms: margarine=butter, white sugar=sugar, plain flour=flour
match_case_results.derivation: 'Plain chocolate' -> chocolate ('plain' is a prep word). Synonym table: margarine -> butter, white sugar and granulated sugar -> sugar, plain flour -> all-purpose flour. 6/6 = 1.0.

match_case_results.description: 'garlic clove' is garlic
match_case_results.derivation: A recipe line 'Garlic Clove' is satisfied by a pantry that has garlic: a clove is garlic. 6/6 = 1.0. The documented rules do not list 'clove' as a cut/variety word, so this rests on what the ingredient means.

match_case_results.description: specificity full: salmon fillet satisfies salmon
match_case_results.derivation: 'fillet' is a listed cut. 3 of 5 matched = 0.6; sake (important) and sesame seed (optional) missing, nothing critical missing.

match_case_results.description: substitution for a CRITICAL ingredient, best of two by flavour impact
match_case_results.derivation: Substitutions: chicken -> chickpeas (significant), firm tofu (significant), seitan (noticeable). Pantry has tofu and seitan; the lower-impact seitan is chosen. A substituted critical ingredient is not missing. (8 + 0.7)/9 = 0.9667.

notes: Dimension 1 baseline SUPERSEDES the earlier F1 0.64 (mistral-medium-2505) and 0.55 (ministral-8b-2512) figures. Two scorer corrections make those numbers non-comparable, and both can only lower a score: (1) a photo where the model identified nothing now counts as a zero instead of being dropped from the mean; (2) 'green onion' no longer matches ground-truth 'onion' (a scallion is not a bulb onion). A lower number than 0.55 is therefore not by itself a model regression.
Dimension 2 now enforces hand-authored constraints (eval/cases.py) in addition to what the pipeline extracted, whole-word avoid matching, and a dimension verdict that requires every case to pass.

Dimension 2 corrections after run_1793926853: expectations for d2_10, d2_12 and d2_30 were corrected (see eval/cases.py CORRECTIONS); only a user-STATED cook-time limit is enforced by the scorer, not the profile default. The pipeline changed too: stated-vs-default cook time, relaxation on 'nothing cookable', code-level avoid-list exclusion, and a deterministic dietary-restriction backstop. Compare this run to run_1793926853 with those changes in mind; they are not like-for-like.
